correctness.rationale: For X_r=C5 corona with r>=2 pendant leaves per core vertex, all 5(r-1) intra-leaf contrasts have eigenvalue -2^p; the five cycle Fourier modes yield two types of 2x2 nonconstant blocks and one zero-mass constant mode. The latter crosses uniquely where r(2·4^p-2^p-2·3^p)=2^p, with p_r in (1,9/7). Exact 9/7 rational interval tests give 2H-u=0.036969421..., E_{z-}=0.031225932..., T=1.078326041..., and exponential-polynomial Descartes sign variation ensures both nonconstant blocks are strictly negative throughout needed range. Critical nullity is one and rank 5(r+1)-2; strictness at lower p follows from Li–Weston, failure at higher p from the constant-mode witness. Taylor inversion yields the stated r^-1,r^-2 asymptotic. Independent graph-distance spectra for r=2,3,5,8 reproduce root and nullity; numerical checks alone do not prove infinite r or real p.
